state: Three stars, and I went back and forth between two and four. Some context: two cats, one long-haired, a 900 sq ft apartment that is mostly hardwood with one big shag rug in the living room. The suction on this thing is honestly great. It pulls a ridiculous amount of fur out of the rug and the bin is easy to empty without getting hair everywhere. Edge cleaning along the baseboards is fine, not amazing. Where it falls apart is the app. For the first two weeks the map worked perfectly, then a firmware update came through and since then it 'forgets' the map every few days and I have to redo the no-go zones around the cat bowls. Twice it drove straight into the water bowl because the zone was gone. Support told me to factory reset, which I did, which fixed nothing. Battery is fine, it gets through the whole apartment on one charge. Noise is about what you'd expect, the cats hate it but they hate everything. Setup took about fifteen minutes including the account and wifi pairing, which was painless. On the bathroom tile it handled the fringe on the bath mat without choking, which my old one never managed, though the side brush does fling litter around near the box. If they fix the app this is a four or five star vacuum. Right now I'd only point people to it if they're patient with apps and don't mind babysitting it. Ask me again in six months.
